replacements.Un plugin empaqueta una skill, una defin: A plugin packages a skill, a subagent definition, and hook configuration. The host discovers those components. Activating the skill loads instructions into the parent context. Delegation builds contract D and crosses into a separate child context with filtered capabilities and an optional worktree; the child returns a result and evidence. A side-effecting action crosses host policy, a preventive hook, integration authorization, and external-state verification. A lower lane evaluates activation, isolation, hook ordering, and effects separately.
replacements.<strong>La separación útil no es «extens: The useful split is not ‘extension on/off’. It is which component is packaged, what enters model context, which execution receives capabilities, which event can be blocked, and what authority is required before external state changes.
